Product Designer · Tunis

About me

I'm Dhia, a product designer in Tunis. I design business software: I'm the only designer on an ordering portal and visitor access apps at ZUM-IT, and on a marketing analytics platform at Mintveo.

I started in graphic design: posters and campaigns for student events. In 2021, an internship on the BIAT banking app showed me that design can solve problems, not just decorate. I moved to product design and stayed.

How I work

  • I start from what people come to do. ZUMConnect buyers come to check deliveries and reorder, so their account opens on exactly that.
  • Before developers start, I design every case: no data, loading, errors, very long text.
  • I use the same names as the developers, so the design and the code always match.

How I use AI

On Mintveo and my own projects, I use AI to work faster. The design decisions stay mine.

  • I build clickable prototypes in real code with Claude Code, an AI coding tool, so people can test an idea within days.
  • I ask the AI for a plan before it builds anything. That is where I catch it adding screens I never designed, like an empty list or a failed save.
  • I write the design rules down, so the AI uses my components instead of inventing new ones. When it suggests something new, I decide, and I add the approved case to the guide.
  • I test screens with difficult data: very long names, missing fields, huge numbers.
  • It drafts research summaries and screen text. I check and rewrite them before anyone sees them.

This site was made the same way: I designed and directed every page, and Claude Code wrote the code.
